name: Venomancer: Charm of Warding learned mid-fight heals on Exposed Flesh stacks from hits (#9721)
contract: #9721: a level 31 Venomancer learned Charm of Warding (705967) mid-fight in Shadowfang Keep and saw no heal when
Exposed Flesh (805095) stacks were gained. Client and server Spell.dbc agree with AscensionDB/SUB: 'When a stack of
Exposed Flesh is applied you are now healed for $s1% of your maximum health' ($s1 = 1). The existing #5546 scenario
covers only Molt; this one drives the hit path: in Beetle Form, hostile hits proc 805098 (92144's helper), which
calls Expose(player, 1). The talent is learned while the attackers are already swinging, Exposed Flesh is cleared
below its cap, and each newly gained stack must log a Charm of Warding heal (spell_heal_count from native heal logs).

steps.label: SETUP: the attackers are in combat
SETUP: hits grant Exposed Flesh before the talent is learned
SETUP: no Charm of Warding heal without the talent
SETUP: Charm of Warding is active while in combat
Clear Exposed Flesh below its cap
SETUP: hits grant new Exposed Flesh stacks
DISCRIMINATING: each stack gained from a hit logs a Charm of Warding heal
